solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Unlikely books to be pinched by engineers

indicators.note: something pinched by another is squeezed between its sides, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps
OT is the Old Testament, the books of the Bible's first part

explanation.surface: Some volumes are improbably going to be stolen by a team of engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: A remote chance is a slim one, so remote is a synonym for improbable or unlikely.

clue.text: Rule accepting last of employees leave voluntarily

indicators.note: accepting means taking something in, so a letter goes inside

parts.note: to rule is to reign

indicators.note: the last letter of the word employees is wanted

explanation.surface: A regulation lets the final worker quit of their own accord.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to quit a post of one's own choice.

clue.text: Gave support for the mafia in large numbers

parts.note: the Mob is a name for organised crime, the Mafia
to lend a hand is to support, so gave a hand gives handed

explanation.surface: Someone backed the gangsters in great force.
explanation.definitionFit: Mob-handed is British slang for in a large group, in force.

clue.text: Aggressively announce the result of a lightning strike

definitions.meaning: to say something loudly and forcefully

definitions.text: the result of a lightning strike
definitions.meaning: the crash heard after a flash of lightning

explanation.definitionFit: To thunder is to bellow; thunder is the noise caused by lightning.

clue.text: Appropriate art form

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to appropriate is to take for oneself, to steal or extract
a non-representational style of painting or sculpture

explanation.definitionFit: To abstract is to remove or purloin; abstract art is a non-figurative art form.

clue.text: One rings before sailing — no time for complaining

indicators.note: before puts the ringer ahead of the sailing piece

parts.note: a bell is something that rings

indicators.note: no time means the letter T, for time, is taken away

parts.note: yachting is sailing for sport

explanation.surface: A bell sounds before a boat trip, with someone grumbling about there being no time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bellyaching is informal for moaning or complaining.

clue.text: It's back, ultra fashionable, in name only

indicators.note: back means the word it is turned backwards

parts.note: the 's is the verb is; the letters come from It

indicators.note: fashioned letters are shaped into a new form

explanation.surface: A trend is said to be back and very much in vogue, but only nominally.
explanation.definitionFit: A titular head holds the title in name only, without real power.

clue.text: Ladies in a feminine environment become stand-offish

indicators.note: an environment surrounds something, so the outer pieces go round it

parts.note: the ladies is a women's lavatory, a loo

explanation.surface: Women in an all-female setting turn distant.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloof means distant and reserved, the same as stand-offish.

clue.text: Audacity — virtue they heartlessly welcomed

indicators.note: welcomed means taken in, so one piece goes inside another
heartless here removes one inner letter from the word they

parts.note: merit is worth or virtue

explanation.surface: A bold remark that goodness was received without feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartlessly' drops the H from THEY, leaving TEY, into which MERIT goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Temerity is reckless boldness, effrontery or audacity.

clue.text: Put down cash advance to be paid

parts.note: a sub is an advance on wages
money due is owed, still to be paid

explanation.surface: Someone hands over a deposit on a loan that must be repaid.
explanation.definitionFit: To put down a revolt is to quell or subdue it; the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Place for training shoes like this?

definitions.meaning: read as 'place for train-ing', where trains stop and passengers board at a station
a style of footwear with very thick soles

explanation.definitionFit: A station platform is where trains pull in; platform shoes have thick raised soles.

clue.text: With caution, moved around ugly adder

indicators.note: letters moved around are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Warily, someone shifted an unpleasant-looking snake out of the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking guardedly means doing so cautiously, without giving much away.

clue.text: Lost credit on air for being dogmatic

indicators.note: letters that are lost wander off and come back in a different order

explanation.surface: A broadcaster lost a credit on air because of a rigid stance.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctrinaire means rigidly adhering to a doctrine, synonymous with dogmatic.

clue.text: Archer's final letter on biography from prisoner

parts.note: a biography is a life story, a life

indicators.note: the final letter of the word Archer's, ignoring the apostrophe, is wanted

explanation.surface: Novelist Jeffrey Archer's last missive appears in a biography of a convict.
explanation.walkthrough: Jeffrey Archer, the British novelist and politician, served a prison sentence, which colours the surface; the 'on' places the letter after LIFE in this across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifer is a prisoner serving a life sentence, a slang term for such a convict.

clue.text: Manage with up-to-date power supply

parts.note: to manage a project is to direct it
current means present-day, up to date

explanation.surface: An instruction to run things with a modern electricity source.
explanation.definitionFit: Direct current is electrical power flowing one way, as from a battery, a kind of power supply.

clue.text: The height of joy, covering English victory

indicators.note: covering means wrapping round, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: elation is great joy
V is the sign and abbreviation for victory

explanation.surface: The peak of happiness, wrapped up in a national win.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevation is height above sea level or a reference point.

clue.text: Vital containers

parts.note: read as containers of vitals, the bony enclosures holding the heart and lungs

explanation.definitionFit: The bony frame of the chest encloses vital organs such as the heart and lungs.

clue.text: Serve tea — dinner-time is a bit vague

indicators.note: to serve dishes is to deal them out, read here as dishing the letters out in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the timing of the evening meal and tea service is rather uncertain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is a bit' links; the hyphen in dinner-time adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indeterminate is not fixed or defined, hence uncertain or vague.

clue.text: Finish without justification for crime

indicators.note: the finish of the word without is its last letter

parts.note: a reason is a justification

explanation.surface: Ending something with no good grounds is a punishable offence.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is the crime of betraying one's country or sovereign.

clue.text: Try a case of typist embracing office worker

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so a piece goes within
the case of a word is its outside, its first and last letters

parts.note: a temp is a temporary office worker

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a typist on trial for hugging a colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is a try or effort.

clue.text: Surrounds live group on top of stage

parts.note: to be is to live, to exist
a set is a group

indicators.note: top of in a down clue means the first letter of the word stage

explanation.surface: A live band appears above a theatre stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' places the S below the other pieces in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Besets means surrounds or hems in, as with troubles.

clue.text: Stop and relax after the 2nd of October

indicators.note: after places the relax piece behind the October letter
the second letter of the word October is wanted

parts.note: to ease off is to relax

explanation.surface: An instruction to halt work and unwind after the start of autumn's second month.
explanation.definitionFit: To cease is to come to a stop, to halt.

clue.text: Help against area in trouble

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other

parts.note: to ail is to trouble
V stands for versus, against

explanation.surface: Assistance is set against a district experiencing difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or help, as in to no avail.

clue.text: Terrible experience caused by the margin being flexible

indicators.note: letters that are flexible bend into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A printer's ordeal comes from a page border that will not stay fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightmare is a bad dream, and by extension any horrible ordeal.

clue.text: Hide from people related to Aries?

parts.note: the ram of the zodiac, loosely taken as a goat (genitive goat's), the question mark admitting the stretch
kin are relatives, people related by family

explanation.surface: Someone hides from relatives of a person born under the sign of the ram.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb, but it is the noun, a pelt; 'from' and 'to' link.
explanation.definitionFit: Goatskin is the hide of a goat, used as leather.

clue.text: Territory commanded before accepting one elected individual

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
an MP is a Member of Parliament, someone elected
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An order from someone giving way to a lone elected politician.
explanation.definitionFit: An empire is a realm or territory ruled over by an emperor.

clue.text: A car spares shop may have one over a barrel!

definitions.text: A car spares shop may have one over a barrel!

parts.words: A car spares shop may have one over a barrel!
parts.note: a motor-parts shop stocks an exhaust muffler, and a gun's quieting device fits over its barrel; being 'over a barrel' also suggests a customer at the shop's mercy

explanation.definitionFit: A silencer is both a car exhaust muffler and a device fitted to a gun barrel to deaden noise.

clue.text: Goes without periods of work

definitions.meaning: to stint oneself is to go without, to economise

explanation.definitionFit: Stints means skimps or goes without; stints are also spells of work.
